question: Within a 110 kilometers range, where can I find a restaurant on the way to Harford Artists Gallery, Bel Air, MD from Rollins Avenue Park, Capitol Heights, MD?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS geom FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Rollins Avenue Park%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Harford Artists Gallery%' LIMIT 1 ), path_buffer AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(s.geom, e.geom)::geography, 110000) AS buffered_path_geog FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, path_buffer pb WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, pb.buffered_path_geog);
